No. 2008/6 – MONDAY, FEBRUARY 27, 2017
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My No.: MADU/L/03/632. Land Min. No.: 4/3/9/2015/WS/106.

I hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for the Land Acquisition for the Construction water tank of Moneragala Medulla water project.

Description of the land to be acquired: Allotments of Land in F.V.P. 594, Suppliment No. 23, Sheet No. 23 prepared by the superintend surveyor in Monaragala, situated in Obbegoda village in the Madulla Divisional Secretary’s Division of the District of Monaragala in Uva Province described as follows:
1. Lot No. 1092 Name of the land: Mahalinde wattha; Owner: State; Prior Claimant: Wijayalath Pelage Pahma - M.O.H. Road, Siriwijithapura, Moneragala; Extent: 0.1012 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land hereby agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Madulla Divisional Secretariat on the 15th day of May, 2017 at 10.00 a..m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 05th day of April, 2017 the nature of their interests in the Land, the particulars or their claims for Compensation of the said

land the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. R. M. R. S. THILAKARATNA, Divisional Secretary, Madulla. Divisional Secretariat, Madulla, 22nd February, 2017. 03 - 457

General, situated in the village of Vijithapura in Kalagam Korale North Minor Division in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Implogama in Anuradhapura District, North Central Province, with following names and bounded as follows:
Lot No. 244 — Name of the Land: Vijithapura Landa; Names and Address of the Claimants: 1. Nagur Pichche Mohamad Nizaar, Polwatta, Vijithapura; Extent: 0.0043 Hectares.
Boundaries: North: Lot No. 243 and 248; East: Lot No. 248; South: Lot No. 247 and 246; West: Lot No. 246, 245 and 243.
All Persons interested in the aforesaid land are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at the Divisional

Secretary’s Office, at Ipalogama on the 27th day of March, 2017 at 10.30 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 20th day of March, 2017, the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said lands, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. M. S. S. SAJIDA BANU, Divisional Secretary, Ipalogama. Divisional Secretariat, Ipalogama, 16th February, 2017. 03 - 458
